{{Top|leg}}
'''Sun rooms''' were artificial environment spaces which approximated natural lighting conditions in an effort relieve the tension from [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] travelling under artificial light. In general, sun rooms were designed for the rich and famous, although they found use in large [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] and luxurious [[Hotel/Legends|hotels]]. The [[Deluxe Sun Room]] was produced by [[zZip Product Concepts Limited]].
